name: app.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app.scss — MANIFEST for the DOCUMENT-level shell stylesheet (the only
//  eager <link>-delivered sheet). The shell was split by surface into
//  app/ partials; document-critical partials are imported below, while
//  shadow-scoped surfaces compile as their own component stylesheets:
//    app/nav-shell.scss      AppNav shadow sheet — nav bar, burger, menu
//                            overlay, plasma logo line, flag
//    app/cookies-banner.scss CookieBanner shadow sheet — consent banner
//
//  Document partials:
//    _chrome        <app-nav> mount + view wrapper + dialog display rules
//    _skeleton      skeleton shimmer placeholders
//    _keyframes     shared slide/dash motion keyframes
//    _progress-bar  route progress bar
//    _transitions   fade/slide page transitions + reduced-motion override
//
//  Declares the CSS cascade-layer order (base → layout → components →
//  overrides → ios-compat). Layout: nav is fixed top; the menu overlay is
//  a fixed fullscreen layer above content but below dialogs.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';
@import '../../base/grid-overlay';
@import 'intro-loader';

// ── CSS Cascade Layers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Declaring the layer ORDER here ensures the cascade priority is locked in,
// regardless of which file imports which layer first.
// Layers: base → layout → components → overrides → ios-compat
// Un-layered rules (most of this codebase) are always stronger than any layer,
// so this declaration is non-breaking — it's purely additive for future use.
@layer base, layout, components, overrides, ios-compat;

@import 'app/chrome';
@import 'app/skeleton';
@import 'app/keyframes';
@import 'app/progress-bar';
@import 'app/transitions';
